title: Keep engine choices synchronized through prose and Astro navigation

browser.storage_denial: --disable-local-storage (real Chromium Web Storage disable: window.localStorage is null/throws, never a monkey-patched prototype)

build.note: real docs build over the 56-item generated dataset; ClientRouter, both engine panels, and the root pre-paint script all emit.

typecheck.note: root tsc --noEmit (tests/**/*.ts included) + registry typecheck both exit 0.

lint.note: 0 errors, 0 warnings; 4 pre-existing info-level useTemplate hints in tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/scaffold.build.test.ts (untouched by this task).

task_test.result: 15 passed (5 ACs x chromium-desktop/mobile/nojs), 0 failed, 0 skipped

red.observed: fresh root data-engine was null (no pre-paint resolution); 4 unique tab/panel IDs instead of 8 (tab-nativewind/tab-uniwind duplicated across the Install and Dependencies groups); cross-group selection did not synchronize; root data-engine stayed null after click and keyboard activation.

green.observed: fresh root data-engine = nativewind; 8 unique tab/panel IDs across 2 groups, each aria-controls/aria-labelledby resolving inside its owning group; clicking uniwind in Dependencies synchronizes both groups + rnr-engine + root data-engine to uniwind, URL stays /components/message; ArrowRight wraps to nativewind in both groups, ArrowLeft restores uniwind; exactly one tabindex=0 per group and keyboard focus follows the selected tab.

red.observed: first-paint root data-engine was null for persisted uniwind (no pre-paint engine resolution); malformed/absent inputs produced no resolved root engine.

green.observed: persisted uniwind resolves root data-engine to uniwind at first paint (MutationObserver captures the pre-paint inline script, before the deferred island); nativewind resolves likewise; bogus-engine, empty string, and absent input resolve to the documented nativewind default; selecting uniwind replaces malformed storage; under a real --disable-local-storage denial, initial engine is nativewind with one readable panel per group, and selecting uniwind still switches both groups + root despite the denied write.

red.observed: no ClientRouter (soft-navigation window probe failed — navigation was a full load); no html.dark marker; engine state not restored across navigation.

green.observed: ClientRouter soft navigation preserves a window probe (soft nav, not a full load); after swap and reload root data-engine and rnr-engine equal uniwind; Install shows https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/message.json; real clipboard equals npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/message.json; html.light/html.dark are complementary in light and dark including after swap and reload; filtering message retains the /components/message card and clearing restores the original 39-card count; 3 repeated message/back cycles leave a single click producing one consistent activation with no engine state in any URL.

red.observed: raw message response carried only 4 unique tab/panel IDs (duplicates across the two groups), violating the 8-unique-ID contract.

green.observed: GET / and /components/message both return HTTP 200 with complete nativewind + uniwind install commands (conversation on /, message on /components/message); the message response carries 8 unique tab/panel IDs across 2 groups; with JavaScript disabled both labeled panels are stacked, visible, and readable (the :not(:defined) fallback), and ordinary links reach /components and /components/message with 200.

red.observed: the old TabGroup ignored the persistent=false generic group contract — no data-persistent attribute, non-unique IDs across the 3 groups, and selecting pnpm wrote pnpm into rnr-engine.

green.observed: a real OS-derived scratch Astro consumer built from the candidate's actual TabGroup.astro + tab-group.ts composes 2 engine groups + 1 nonpersistent generic group with 12 unique tab/panel IDs; selecting pnpm displays pnpm add example while rnr-engine and root data-engine remain uniwind; selecting nativewind synchronizes both engine groups while the generic group stays pnpm; after reload the generic group returns to npm install example and the engine groups restore nativewind; storage contains only the engine value, never npm/pnpm.

design_notes.unique_group_identity: TabGroup renders panels exactly once through Astro.slots.render and re-injects via set:html; an explicit `group` prop wins, otherwise a deterministic sha256 digest of the first panel's rendered slot disambiguates co-located groups without editing InstallCommand/DependencyPanel (and without the double-slot-render that consumed child-component script hoisting).
design_notes.shared_engine_contract: one resolveEngine (nativewind/uniwind only, nativewind default) is used both by the pre-paint inline script (root data-engine before paint) and the tab-group island (click/keyboard activation). A persistent group's activation sets root data-engine, writes rnr-engine, and applies visibility + ARIA to every engine group on the page; generic (data-persistent=false) groups are local-only.
design_notes.complementary_theme_marker: html.dark is derived from the same resolved light boolean as html.light; a window-guarded MutationObserver keeps html.dark complementary after ThemeToggle clicks (theme-toggle.ts owns the light flip and is writeProhibited here).
design_notes.client_router: ClientRouter is added to the shared DocsLayout head; bundled islands reconnect per-instance in connectedCallback, and the data-astro-rerun pre-paint script restores root engine/theme markers across swaps.
